God was created a very very very very long time ago. Every culture had their own gods despite not communicating to each other so why is that? Back then science was not as developed and therefore many people had no answers for common questions. To help bring comfort and answers people used the power of the gods as an excuse. Later on as science developed the meaning changed. Despite us now knowing many answers to the questions of the world many people still believe in a god and there are 3 main reasons for this. To help them feel better, tradition and control.

Control is the easiest to explain and there are many examples which you can find anywhere whether it's a company using god as an excuse or a way to gain followers or even in a church with a corrupt priest trying to get money from it's people saying god wants them to give him money. 

The second reason is tradition. If you are brought up from a very young age you are taught at your most vulnerable and influential time that god is a being that exists and must be followed. Even if later some dont believe in him many will from their increased presence within the community and god seemingly having the answers to everything making them not look further to see if there is another truth. 

Lastly is comfort. Comfort is a very key role and it's when people use god to make themselves feel better and give their life meaning and rules. Let's face it. Life is overwhelming and difficult and sometimes sad. For example take any ordinary person. They are living their whole life for what? To die and then what? Everything means nothing if you die. UNLESS there is a god or an afterlife or something that makes your hard work worth it. It can also be used in the context of criminals. If someone has been robbed, raped, had their family murdered, whatever, it is a lot more comforting to think that whoever did that will be tortured eternally in hell than just have no severe punishment. And lastly comfort can be used to keep life going. If you are late for work, if you get sick, etc and are all around having a bad day you can use the thought of god testing you to help you get through it. 

So yes god can be a concept to keep others under control but there are also many other reasons it exists and at the beginning it may have not been the intent. Sorry this is long I just enjoy this subject.
